overview_description.description: Dexterity offers robots as a service solution for logistics, warehousing, and supply chain operations. The company provides a 'robots as a service' model, which allows businesses to efficiently integrate robotics into their supply chain operations. Dexterity's flagship product, DexR, is a two-armed robot designed for tasks like truck loading, equipped with machine vision and force sensing technologies.

product.name: Dexterity Physical AI Platform
product.description: An enterprise robotics platform that coordinates perception, planning, motion, force control, and specialized AI agents to automate complex physical workflows.

product.name: Mech
product.description: A dual-arm industrial robot with mobile navigation, force sensing, and Physical AI for autonomous material handling, including truck loading, unloading, palletizing, and depalletizing.

product.name: Foresight
product.description: A physics-aware world model that fuses sensor data, robot state, and interaction outcomes to support real-time perception, spatial reasoning, planning, and safe manipulation.

product.name: Physical AI Robotic Automation Deployments
product.description: Deployment and integration of AI-powered robotic systems for logistics and industrial workflows such as truck loading, palletizing, depalletizing, unloading, and parcel handling.
